name: Kamishiro Saya
source: Saya, the wife of Kamishiro Ikki and mother to Ririko, cherishes Mamoru and Kotone as if they were her own. Shouldering the weight of the Kamishiro family in place of her sickly husband, she traverses across the country offering her support. In the face of a looming deadline to produce a male heir, Saya grapples with mounting desperation.
